_comment: Per-clip locomotion metadata. blend_in_seconds = how long to crossfade INTO this clip. family = pose-family tag for the cross-family blend extender (cross_family_min_blend_seconds). Within-family transitions (e.g. walking <-> running) use the per-clip blend_in_seconds; across-family (e.g. unarmed_combat_idle <-> running) get bumped to the cross-family minimum so the wider pose gap doesn't snap visibly. Family is open-ended; common values are 'gait' (mid-stride neutral arms) and 'idle' (stationary stance). To add a new clip, add a row here with its family — no C++ changes needed.
